pages.text: There are many ways of automating $(l:items_blocks_machines/processors)processors$(/l), and this is one of them.$(br2)This general layout can be done with any type of item logistics pipe or conduit or duct or whatever the mod calls it, as long as you can filter it.
Here is detailed how to do it with just AE2, using $(l:example_setups/pipe_subnet)"pipe" subnets$(/l).

Note that since this uses a $(l:items_blocks_machines/pattern_provider)ME Pattern Provider$(/l), it is meant to integrate into your $(l:ae2_mechanics/autocrafting)autocrafting$(/l) setup. If you just want to automate a processors standalone, replace the pattern provider with another barrel, and directly put the ingredients in the upper barrel.$(br2)This happens to be backwards-compatible with previous AE2 versions, because even if the $(l:items_blocks_machines/inscriber)Inscriber$(/l)s are sided, the pipe subnets still

insert to and extract from the correct faces.$(br2)$(bold)A Lesson In Pattern Encoding$()$(br2)Often, the $(l:items_blocks_machines/patterns)pattern$(/l) you need to encode $(bold)WILL NOT MATCH WHAT YOU SEE IN JEI$(), or what JEI outputs when you click the + button. In this case, JEI will output 2 separate patterns, one for the printed components and one for the final assembly, and the printed components pattern will

include a $(l:items_blocks_machines/presses)press$(/l). This is not what we want, because this is not what the setup will do. We want 1 pattern that inputs the raw resources and outputs the completed processor, and since the press is already in the inscriber, we should not put it in the pattern.$(br2)---$(br2)$(#555)$(o)(3D scene not available in this version)$()

pages.title: Configurations
pages.text: $(li)The $(l:items_blocks_machines/pattern_provider)ME Pattern Provider$(/l) (1) is in its default configuration, with the relevant $(l:items_blocks_machines/patterns)Processing Pattern$(/l)s. Note that the patterns go direct from raw resources to the completed processor, and do $(bold)NOT$() include the $(l:items_blocks_machines/presses)press$(/l).

pages.title: Engineering Pattern
pages.text: $(li)The $(l:items_blocks_machines/storage_bus)ME Storage Bus$(/l)ses (2, 17, 18, 20) are in their default

configurations.$(li)The $(l:items_blocks_machines/export_bus)ME Export Bus$(/l)ses (3-7) are filtered to the relevant ingredient. They have 2 $(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Acceleration Card$(/l)s.$(li)The $(l:items_blocks_machines/import_bus)ME Import Bus$(/l)ses (13-16, 19) are in their default configurations. They have 2 $(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Acceleration Card$(/l)s.$(li)The $(l:items_blocks_machines/inscriber)Inscriber$(/l)s are in their default configurations. They have the relevant $(l:items_blocks_machines/presses)press$(/l), and 4 $(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Acceleration Card$(/l)s.

pages.title: How It Works
pages.text: 1. The $(l:items_blocks_machines/pattern_provider)ME Pattern Provider$(/l) pushes the ingredients into the barrel.$(br2)2. The first $(l:example_setups/pipe_subnet)pipe subnet$(/l) (orange) pulls the silicon, redstone dust, and the relevant processor's ingredient (Gold Ingot, Certus Quartz Crystal, or Diamond) out of the barrel and puts them in the relevant $(l:items_blocks_machines/inscriber)Inscriber$(/l).$(br2)3. The first four $(l:items_blocks_machines/inscriber)Inscriber$(/l)s make the $(l:items_blocks_machines/processors)Printed Silicon$(/l), and

the $(l:items_blocks_machines/processors)Printed Logic Circuit$(/l), $(l:items_blocks_machines/processors)Printed Calculation Circuit$(/l), or $(l:items_blocks_machines/processors)Printed Engineering Circuit$(/l).$(br2)4. The second and third $(l:example_setups/pipe_subnet)pipe subnet$(/l)s (green) take the printed circuits out of the first four $(l:items_blocks_machines/inscriber)Inscriber$(/l)s and put them in the fifth, final assembly $(l:items_blocks_machines/inscriber)Inscriber$(/l).$(br2)5. The fifth $(l:items_blocks_machines/inscriber)Inscriber$(/l) assembles the $(l:items_blocks_machines/processors)processor$(/l).$(br2)6. The fourth $(l:example_setups/pipe_subnet)pipe subnet$(/l) (purple) puts the prcoessor in
the pattern provider, returning it to the main network.
